dct_title_s: El Salvador - Tropical depression on Jun 08 2026
dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[1001275\_13](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_ts_events/items?event_id=1001275) Tropical depression during the period Jun 08 2026-Jun 11 2026 in Honduras, El Salvador, Nicaragua. The center of the storm was located near latitude 13.2 longitude -89.1. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
